Gulf_Dhahran.label: Gulf — Dhahran, Saudi Arabia
Gulf_Dhahran.driver: Ministerial Directive 20/2013 — desalinated water forbidden for cooling; TSE mandated

USA_NorthernVirginia.label: USA — Loudoun County, Virginia
USA_NorthernVirginia.driver: No federal reuse law; state-level water reporting mandates advancing. SC and KS considering closed-loop mandates

Europe_Frankfurt.label: Europe — Frankfurt, Germany
Europe_Frankfurt.driver: EnEfG: PUE <= 1.2 for data centres commissioned from 1 Jul 2026 (within two years); existing <= 1.5 by 1 Jul 2027 and <= 1.3 by 1 Jul 2030. ERF >= 10 % from 1 Jul 2026, 15 % 2027, 20 % 2028. Applies above 300 kW; fines to EUR 100,000

Pakistan_Balloki.label: Pakistan — Balloki / Punjab industrial
Pakistan_Balloki.driver: NEQS effluent limits; Punjab Water Act 2019 abstraction licensing. Water is largely area-billed, so its marginal cost is near zero — the lever here is kWh and the 56 % peak/off-peak spread
